name: retrieval
what_this_is: The labelled dataset for the two search_books metrics - the tool-level
(layer 6) pair, probed directly, no agent in the loop:
`regasire` (recall@3): for each angle, the book that must appear in the
top 3 passages. `carti` lists acceptable titles (substring match, any
of them counts) because some angles are honestly served by several.
`control-negativ`: queries with nothing on her shelf. No per-case
pass/fail - the metric is the SEPARATION between positive and negative
top scores, because measured on 2026-08-26 score alone cannot gate:
an off-topic TikTok-marketing query scored 0.542 (inside the
docstring's good-match band) while a true match scored 0.444.
One case is a deliberate open defect: `oameni-care-nu-pot-spune-nu`
expects The Disease to Please, which a Romanian query cannot reach -
8 of the 17 books are English and near-invisible to Romanian
phrasings (the same angle in English finds them instantly). The case
stays red until that language gap is repaired; it is the detector.
`epuizare-burnout` is the second language detector: all three burnout books are English, and the Romanian query reaches none of them.
Since 2026-08-26 search_books takes description_en as a mandatory second phrasing (bilingual shelf); the dataset carries descriere_en per case for the direct probe.
